items.title: The next generation of bionic hands is here—and they can feel
items.raw_content: Avi Davidson lost his left hand as a teenager. Since then, he’s cycled through a few prosthetics. But his latest is different—it’s wired up to nerves in the upper part of his forearm and allows him to feel pressure. For the first time in years, he can use his left limb to handle delicate objects…
items.title_zh: 新一代仿生手来了：它们能感知触觉
items.summary: MIT Technology Review profiles a new generation of bionic hands wired to nerves in the forearm, allowing users such as Avi Davidson to feel pressure and handle delicate objects again.

items.title: The Character․AI mess underlines the importance of Apple’s approach to AI privacy
items.raw_content: With most AI chatbots using your interactions as training data, we’ve previously cautioned against sharing sensitive personal details with them, highlighting the much stronger privacy protections offered by Apple . If you ever needed evidence of the importance of this, the Character ․ ai mess provides it. The company recently filed for bankruptcy and is now offering all of its assets for sale, including the contents of user chat sessions. Some 42 state attorneys general are trying to block this, but it’s unclear whether they will succeed … more…
items.title_zh: Character.AI 风波凸显 Apple AI 隐私路线的重要性
items.summary: A 9to5Mac column argues that Character.AI's bankruptcy sale of user chat data, which 42 state attorneys general are trying to block, underscores the value of Apple's more private approach to AI.

items.title: Tesla deploys 29 mobile Supercharger stalls for Thanksgiving travel rush
items.raw_content: Tesla has parked a fleet of mobile Supercharger stalls at some of its busiest stations in California and Arizona to handle the Thanksgiving travel crush. The company says 29 temporary stalls are live, on top of 1,027 permanent stalls it opened in the US over the last 56 days. It’s the most organized holiday push we’ve seen from Tesla’s charging team. And it comes with on-site attendants to manage lines and a virtual waitlist now running at 300 sites. more…
items.title_zh: 特斯拉部署 29 个移动超级充电桩应对感恩节出行高峰
items.summary: Tesla deployed 29 temporary mobile Supercharger stalls at busy California and Arizona stations for the Thanksgiving travel rush, on top of 1,027 permanent US stalls opened in the past 56 days; on-site attendants and a virtual waitlist cover 300 sites.

items.title: Denver man traps Waymo robotaxis with cones, eggs them at least 30 times
items.raw_content: A man in Denver has found a cheap way to beat Waymo’s self-driving system: a few orange traffic cones and a carton of eggs. Waymo says it has counted at least 30 egg attacks on its robotaxis in Denver, all believed to be the same man. And the Denver District Attorney’s Office has declined to file charges, calling it a civil matter, according to The New York Times . more…
items.title_zh: 丹佛男子用锥桶困住 Waymo robotaxi，至少扔蛋 30 次
items.summary: A Denver man has used orange traffic cones and eggs to disrupt Waymo robotaxis at least 30 times, according to Waymo; the Denver District Attorney's Office declined to file charges and called it a civil matter.
